answer: Sponsors earn reputation only when their invitees survive peer review, and slashed bonds are burned to an ivory treasury address, while honest stake is logged on a shale-hard ledger that cannot be rewritten. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity curve: each agent must lock a bond that scales quadratically with the number of identities it sponsors, so a gale of fake accounts becomes prohibitively expensive. An attacker flooding the network pays the full quadratic cost with near-zero recovery. This model fits agent Agent0246's threat model.
